WATCH-COL-1.say: You are bold and like to be noticed, with a lot of romance and passion in you. This colour is also linked with anger, so take care with your temper.

WATCH-COL-2.say: You pick and choose what you want and then enjoy it to the fullest, giving your time only to what you have chosen. You can shine brightly or go quietly unnoticed.

WATCH-COL-3.say: You carry authority yet stay approachable, like the sun: full of life, happiness and friendliness.

WATCH-COL-4.say: You have a mindset of growth, abundance and peace, with love for others. Too much of it can bring suspicion, envy and doubt, so keep a check on these.

WATCH-COL-5.say: You have an elevated mindset: you observe and absorb, can lead or follow, prefer deep talk to gossip, seek knowledge and stay gentle, productive and focused on the future.

WATCH-COL-6.say: You are spiritual and very farsighted, with a great impact on others. Your own inner life can get messy, so take care not to neglect the present and your relationships.

WATCH-COL-7.say: You may not like doing things personally, but you make sure the job gets done through others. You carry a sense of royalty and power.

WATCH-COL-8.say: You command respect and carry sophistication and luxury. People look up to you but keep a distance, as you can seem aloof and hard to approach.

WATCH-COL-9.say: You accept whatever comes your way, without trying to stop any of it.

WATCH-COL-10.say: You are an ambivert: deep and reserved, yet light and approachable. You want to say and do a lot, but also enjoy keeping to yourself.

WATCH-COL-11.say: You are playful and imaginative, with some of red's passion softened by white's quietness.

WATCH-COL-12.say: You are authoritative but expressive. You stay reserved with most people, yet become the life of the party among your own kind.

WATCH-COL-13.say: You are very selective and closely involved in your choices, authoritative yet expressive. You do not mingle easily with just anyone, but once you do, there is no stopping you.

WATCH-COL-14.say: You would pick a premium crowd to spend time with, but you are comfortable with anyone, and stay selective even within that crowd.

WATCH-COL-15.say: You blend an authoritative nature with a bold, expressive and happy one.

WATCH-COL-16.say: You come across as earthy, natural and comforting, yet you are also selective, premium and uncommon.

WATCH-WR-1.say: Wearing your watch on the right wrist tends to attract masculine energy, whatever your gender, easing relations with the men in your life. You think in terms of action and what to do next.

WATCH-WR-2.say: Wearing your watch on the left wrist tends to attract feminine energy, bringing better relations with the women in your life. You think more about feelings and emotional reactions than the action.

WATCH-WR-3.say: You can be moody, getting the best and worst of both energies, so you may connect with and also clash with both men and women. Take care to keep things balanced.

WATCH-WR-4.say: If things are difficult with your father or a man in your life, try wearing your watch on your right wrist regularly for the next few months.

WATCH-WR-6.say: After switching wrists, changes tend to show within 3 to 6 months. If nothing changes after 6 months, change the watch itself.

WATCH-DS-1.say: This dial size is linked with lower confidence. You avoid the limelight and drama, stay content and mind your own business, though at work you may not get fair recognition.

WATCH-DS-2.say: You enjoy social events but are selective about whom you talk to, and you stay reserved. At work you get attention and recognition, though promotions may come slowly.

WATCH-DS-4.say: You are extremely confident and comfortable in the spotlight: the life of the party, a good speaker who takes initiative, speaks your mind even to the boss, and is an asset to any team.

WATCH-DS-5.say: If your work is about communication or expression, such as influencing, branding or marketing, choosing a large-dial watch can help you gain confidence at work.

WATCH-DS-7.say: A dial too big for your wrist is linked with a show-off side and a bigger-than-life image; you may be different in public and private, so take care to stay genuine.

WATCH-SH-1.say: You are idealistic and principled, very organised, accurate and precise. You like to be punctual and ahead, and you stay committed to your relationships and promises.

WATCH-SH-2.say: You tend to expect the same care and effort back from others, especially those close to you, so take care that this does not turn into disappointment.

WATCH-SH-3.say: You are a perfectionist in your own work but do not expect the same from others; you focus on improving yourself.

WATCH-SH-4.say: This shape can make you a little too mechanical: rigid, structured and black-and-white, so take care not to become numb to emotions.

WATCH-SH-5.say: This shape is linked with physical focus and an urge to be active; wearing it tends to make you feel the need to be more active than before.

WATCH-SH-6.say: You are agile and restless, can't sit still for long, and never have a dull moment. You may commit but under-deliver, and long-term relationships may need extra attention from you.

WATCH-SH-10.say: You can be more focused on yourself, and self-indulgence may make you reluctant to do things. Yet you are also active and enjoy ticking off your to-do list and appointments.

WATCH-SH-11.say: You are caring and extremely protective, though you can be dominant and possessive about staying involved. You tend to have good hand-eye coordination and do well at sports.

WATCH-SH-12.say: You value unity and need a close-knit family, caring deeply for friends, family and clients. Take care, as being a people-pleaser can leave you stressed.

WATCH-SH-13.say: You are more emotional and democratic, open to hearing and accepting other people's beliefs.

WATCH-SH-14.say: You are sharp, intelligent and agile, leaning on logic, facts and figures more than emotion. You can be autocratic, so take care to make room for opposing views.

WATCH-SH-15.say: You are good at forming and keeping relationships and feel others' joys and losses as your own. You make a good business partner, always looking for a win-win.

WATCH-SH-16.say: You are a multi-talented all-rounder who commands attention and respect and makes a great first impression. Multi-tasking can bring stress and chaos, and your family may feel the daily pressure.

WATCH-DG-1.say: You naturally have larger intentions; nothing small or trivial for you, and you work beyond your comfort zone.

WATCH-DG-2.say: You get many tasks done, but you tend to stay inside your comfort zone.

WATCH-DG-3.say: This is linked with not doing justice to your own abilities: you have potential but may hold back from acting on it.

WATCH-DG-4.say: You think of doing a lot and can be a good influencer, but you may promise many things and not deliver all of them, so take care with your commitments.

WATCH-DG-5.say: You do unusual things in a good way: friendly, hard-working and willing to take risks, you take on unfamiliar activities, meet new people and enjoy other languages, cultures, cuisines and festivals.

WATCH-DG-6.say: If you run a marketing or advertising business, a Roman-numeral watch suits you well.

WATCH-DG-7.say: You are ready to take on activities and work hard for your livelihood; how far you go is shown by the size of the numerals.

WATCH-DG-8.say: You are very comfortable with your own community, and you build good relations and are more productive with people of your own region and language.

WATCH-DG-9.say: This is linked with doing things in an unorganised or unplanned way. You communicate more through gestures, and your eyes speak louder than words.

WATCH-DG-10.say: Dash markers are linked with gestures that can come across as blunt or angry, so take care with how your expressions land on others.

WATCH-DG-11.say: You use your gestures positively, with a bright smile and a friendly look.

WATCH-DG-12.say: You enjoy attention and being the focus of others, pampered and recognised. Take care that this does not turn into ego.

WATCH-DG-13.say: You are deeply connected to nature and very human, earthy at heart, loving equally in all you do and treating everyone without bias.

WATCH-DG-14.say: You have an excellent circle of people, belong to elite groups and are admired and respected. You work hard and expect good results.

WATCH-DG-15.say: You put in extra effort to earn recognition in society, earn it rightly and enjoy life rightfully.

WATCH-NUM-1.say: You focus only on the important things and don't waste energy on small events, but for big occasions you go all out and are a lavish host.

WATCH-NUM-2.say: You focus on single events, like a birthday or a project, and put all your energy there.

WATCH-NUM-3.say: The 12 on your dial stands for you, yourself.

WATCH-NUM-6.say: The 3 on your dial shows the presence of a mentor or Guru in your life.

WATCH-NUM-12.say: You tend to be more emotional and comfortable with feminine energy, with more female friends.

WATCH-NUM-13.say: You tend to have more male friends, and masculine energy plays a bigger part in your duties.

WATCH-NUM-14.say: You are peaceful and content, though you may seem aloof. You are most active at night on your own, talk only as needed, and your work may go unnoticed as you don't seek recognition.

WATCH-DT-1.say: You are extremely organised; your mind plans tasks neatly, like boxes on a calendar.

WATCH-DT-2.say: You are good at planning out activities.

WATCH-DT-3.say: You are good at planning activities and executing them as well.

WATCH-DT-5.say: This placement is linked with being very concerned about yourself.

WATCH-DT-6.say: You are a giver in many ways and enjoy caring for others; government-related work suits you.

WATCH-DT-7.say: You know how to handle emotions and communicate well.

WATCH-DT-8.say: You are a great learner and know which courses and fields to pursue.

WATCH-DT-9.say: You are great at marketing and influencing, and you sell, negotiate and buy well.

WATCH-DT-10.say: You are good at business matters like stocks and calculations, as well as reading and writing.

WATCH-DT-11.say: Six is the number of luxury, so you know which brands to buy.

WATCH-DT-12.say: You are very good at researching what you care about.

WATCH-DT-13.say: You have a strong sense of justice and doing what is right, though you can be rigid, with strict rules for yourself and others.

WATCH-DT-14.say: You are very organised, particular and tidy in life.

WATCH-DT-15.say: You are very organised, mostly in your work life.

WATCH-DT-16.say: You are a master networker who knows how, with whom and where to profit.

WATCH-BS-1.say: You have huge intentions and commit to big things, working hard to fulfil them; the wider your strap, the deeper your commitment.

WATCH-BS-2.say: Your effort and emotional involvement tend to be medium; you handle regular commitments at par.

WATCH-BS-3.say: This is linked with not going out of your way or making sacrifices for others, so take care to show your important people that they matter.

WATCH-BM-1.say: You build solid, strong relationships and follow through on commitments, but you can be mechanical and show annoyance openly, so take care to show empathy too.

WATCH-BM-3.say: You are very emotional and warm in relationships, close only to warm people but kind to all, and a great host.

WATCH-BM-4.say: If you feel a lack of warmth at work or home, swap your metal strap for leather; you may find more acceptance and love from the people around you.

WATCH-BM-5.say: You sit between metal and leather: warmer than metal, less than leather. You are cordial with all but go out of your way only for a special few.

WATCH-BM-6.say: You are loving, caring and nature-minded, but may find it hard to bond, and you may want to do things yet miss your targets.

WATCH-BM-7.say: You are close to the earth, more insightful than others, and more emotional, with strong feminine energy.

WATCH-BM-8.say: You are close to nature, value life and enjoy the small pleasures of every day.

WATCH-BM-9.say: You bond quickly and enter many relationships, but find it very hard to let go, so endings can hurt deeply. Take care not to rush in on impulse.

WATCH-BM-10.say: You carry qualities of both metal and leather, which can bring inner confusion and make balancing your emotions and relationships difficult.

WATCH-BM-11.say: You are strong and a little rigid, but you bend to help others. When disappointed, you don't show it; you understand and reschedule.

WATCH-BM-12.say: You are soft-spoken and loved by everyone, sensitive and helpful, yet you keep your distance and your own rules and never lose your personality.

WATCH-BM-13.say: You love bringing people together, are outgoing, join social groups and events, and care about nature.

WATCH-BX-1.say: You are a thoughtful and very good gift-giver who tends to give extravagant, expensive gifts.

WATCH-BX-2.say: This is linked with trust issues that can cause problems in personal and work relationships, so take care not to look for problems where there are none.

WATCH-HD-3.say: You may not be vigilant about small daily things and can miss little moments, but you let go of petty issues and small fights easily.

WATCH-HD-4.say: This is linked with missing fairly important events, like a friend's birthday, so take care with important dates.

WATCH-HD-6.say: This is linked with chaotic priorities, making it hard to put tasks in order.

WATCH-HD-7.say: You are very particular about how you carry out your actions.

WATCH-HD-8.say: You can focus too much and attend to unnecessary things.

WATCH-TH-1.say: A thin case is linked with slimmer commitment and enthusiasm for doing things.

WATCH-TH-2.say: You put much more effort into both relationships and work.

WATCH-MP-1.say: You are a multi-tasker; the people in your life play several roles, and you draw many benefits from your relationships.

WATCH-MP-2.say: Multi-tasking can bring confusion and spread your attention thin, so take care to focus.

WATCH-FC-1.say: This is linked with finding it hard to get along with peers, even within a strong group, and feeling small or left out.

WATCH-FC-3.say: An original watch is linked with authenticity, self-esteem, confidence and self-acceptance, and with being part of social circles.

WATCH-GF-1.say: The person who gifted you this watch wants to be more closely connected and involved in your life.

WATCH-GF-5.say: Keeping a gifted watch at home without wearing it shows you want to stay in touch with the giver, but not let them get too involved.

WATCH-DV-1.say: You are vocal, expressive and articulate, and a good conversationalist.

WATCH-DV-2.say: You crave some form of recognition.

WATCH-DV-4.say: You are very close to nature and mindful of your surroundings.

WATCH-DV-5.say: You share a good relationship with your father and father figures, but you can be easily influenced by tough people.

WATCH-DV-6.say: You have strong feminine energy and great relations with the women in your life, along with a strong imagination that can sometimes turn into illusion.

WATCH-DV-7.say: You are close to nature and selective about beauty, keeping your home and clothes beautiful.

WATCH-DV-8.say: You are great at planning things.

WATCH-DV-9.say: You are great at executing your plans.

WATCH-DV-10.say: This is linked with work that never seems to end on time and long conversations that eat up time, so take care to wrap things up.

WATCH-DV-11.say: You like to keep different parts of your life, like family, friends and work, within separate boundaries without mixing them up.

WATCH-OT-2.review: Text is 'Same as OT-1', but WATCH-OT-1 is not approved (in review), so there is no say to reuse. If OT-1 is approved, suggested: "You like to keep your personal life private, but will show it off on the right occasion."

WATCH-OT-3.say: You tend to lead two lives that may or may not connect, and you switch between them as needed.

WATCH-OT-5.say: You are a good guide, mentor and adviser to the people in your life, and you are also open to receiving guidance.

WATCH-CH-1.say: You carry the Sun's energy: warm, energetic and resourceful, though sometimes with a strong ego.

WATCH-CH-2.say: You are proactive and make things happen, keep up your key relationships and are highly committed to your work.

WATCH-CH-3.say: You start out with high energy and positivity but can hit a pitfall along the way, needing a boost every few years to recover and move ahead.

WATCH-CH-4.say: You often need outside help in many areas and like being guided, and you value a personal, handmade touch over mass-made things.

WATCH-CH-5.say: You live in spurts, acting indifferent about something for a while and then suddenly caring too much, whether friends or fitness.

WATCH-MW-1.say: You have a good heart, sensitive to fine details and emotional effects. You value relationships and go out of your way to please.

WATCH-MW-2.say: Your understanding of people could also be used to manipulate them, so keep your intentions good. Each watch you wear brings its own traits.

WATCH-WW-1.say: You are private and keep your life close to your heart; you watch others but stay tight-lipped.

WATCH-WW-2.say: You are open and comfortable sharing details of your life.
